original: Sheep's Head, also known as Muntervary, is the headland at the end of the Sheep's Head peninsula situated between Bantry Bay and Dunmanus Bay in County Cork, Ireland.
translated: Sheep's Head, auch bekannt als Muntervary, ist die Landzunge am Ende der Halbinsel Sheep's Head zwischen Bantry Bay und Dunmanus Bay in County Cork, Irland.
